verdict.rationale: Lever ships AI features (Talent Fit, AI Form Builder, interview summaries), so asking whether its AI can consume tools from external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions MCP or any way to plug in external tool servers. The marketplace integrations, REST API and webhooks are adjacent integration mechanisms, not MCP-client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
